notes: *none* is the rule 35 fusion of the universal כֹּל with the clause's לֹא — one English word answering to two morphemes — headed on the negative, discontinuous across the object phrase; giving the word to one and marking the other unrepresented is what that rule forbids.
The suffix of יְשִׂימָם is unrepresented under rule 22: the ASV's *them* stands in the following clause and belongs to the suffix of נְתָנָם.
מַדְוֵי takes the *of* of *none of the ... diseases* as the rectum of כֹּל (rule 19).
